$comment: The project mail address contract between the Email Worker (deploy/pulumi/src/platform/inbound-mail-worker.js, which routes on it) and the BFF (frontends/ui/src/lib/inbound-mail/address.ts, which parses and mints it). A recipient is a project address when, after ASCII lowercasing, stripping surrounding angle brackets and quotes and a +detail subaddress, the text after the LAST dot of the local part (or the whole local part) matches tokenPattern. Both sides run every case below in their specs (inbound-mail-worker.spec.ts, address.spec.ts), so neither can change the rule alone.

cases.note: a project whose name has nothing Latin in it: the bare token
a subaddress is dropped before the split
twelve base32 letters look like a token; a company address like this needs its own literal routing rule, which Cloudflare matches before the catch-all
1 is not in the base32 alphabet
only the text after the last dot counts
the Kelvin sign must not fold onto k
everything after the plus is the subaddress
